name: Workshop Update Gate
actions: explicitly enable or disable update checks
check the canonical GitHub main ref
stage a matching archive without installing it
summary: Keep a Workshop local and independent by default, then optionally use Heartbeat-gated canonical GitHub checks and signed archive staging when its owner turns updates on.
notes: OFF performs zero updater network reads. The current foundation can check and cryptographically stage, but it cannot install, overwrite, delete, restart, merge, promote, or roll back a whole Workshop.
